name: Renkinjutsu no Musume
source:
Hero was born in a rich house and he uses assets to finance extreme alchemy experiments to recover lost secrets. There are three students in this academy to take care of and try new inventions effects in dungeons with.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公出生在富裕家庭，他利用资产资助极端的炼金术实验，以找回失落的秘密。在这所学院里有三名学生需要照顾，并与她们一起在地下城中试验新发明的效果。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
